record_title: Sharp lower bound for average maximal matchings in cyclic graphs
limitations: The universal lower bound applies for cyclomatic number r>=2, but the exact fixed-(n,r) minimum is established only for n>=r+2; the denser range n<r+2 is not classified. The maximum problem is not addressed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual uncertainty from the uninspected full text of Engbers-Erey (2023) and differently indexed or very recent work.
